title: Master Checklist
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Every step of the college admissions process in one interactive checklist, with Scout the Turtle walking the road as you finish each stage.

learningObjectives: Students will carry out and track each step of the admissions process in order, deciding which steps apply to their own path.

controls: Stage menu with previous and next buttons
Doesn't apply to me checkboxes on optional steps

keyQuestions: Which steps don't apply to your path, and how did you decide?
Which stage looks hardest, and what could you start early to make it easier?
Who can help you with the steps you're least sure about?
commonMisconceptions: Every student has to complete every step in the same way.
If you start late, you have already missed your chance.
assessmentOpportunities: Students keep the checklist current and can explain why they marked any step as not applying to them.
